question: Which lattices can a law of the fourteen terms tell from a random graph of the same degree? A start a law cannot tell from such a graph can be kept or preferred by no law, so it is no start to grow a law from: study 159 held none of its 15,675 honeycomb chains.
rule: A term tells a lattice when its energy a node on the lattice, taken alone with coupling 1 and scale one (an anchored term anchored at the lattice's degree), differs from its mean over random regular graphs of the same size and degree by at least `tells_at_least` at the largest size read, and that difference is at least `keeps_at_least` of the one at the smallest size read: an amount a node that does not shrink with N. A start is admitted when its degree is under the cap, it is built at every size read, and at least one term tells it. A prediction is right when the terms that tell the lattice are exactly the ones expected; the criterion passes when every lattice is admitted or not as expected, and it says beside that which term lists differ.
